model: Original constant temporary impact; deterministic external-volume quotas known at planning time.
quota: q_k <= floor(rho*V_k), decimal input semantics; V excludes the seller's own trades.
benchmark: Arrival shortfall, paired on the same external Gaussian price innovations.
failure: Report continuous or integer capacity shortage and maximal possible shares; no fabricated completion or comparison of incomplete costs.
limits: Forecast capacity is not guaranteed actual liquidity; no real order book, partial fills, live trading or endogenous market volume.
